text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock C above my average cost did not by itself make those sales wise; I should compare each trade with the stock’s prospects and my portfolio needs.","My account value fell despite some profitable sales, so I should judge results across the whole portfolio rather than treating each stock as a separate account.","I should neither cling to losing positions to avoid admitting a mistake nor trade without good reason; use evidence, risk, and diversification to guide decisions."]}
